svg.title: Posterior style-to-quality ratios by fold
svg.desc: Each point is a posterior median; whiskers are 90 percent intervals. Dashed lines are prior medians. Missing micro-scale sites are not plotted.

g.text: Posterior r by fold — common logarithmic scale
Dots: median; whiskers: 90% interval; dashed line: prior median. No rₖ site in folds 1 and 21.
